fusions.name: Raking Swipe
fusions.desc: A quick swipe that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Throat Seeker
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 32 damage, always strikes critically, and makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Soundless Drop
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 5 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Ninth Life
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
